scope: Display-referred appearance calibration only. Unknown camera poses and unknown editorial processing prevent geometric or absolute-radiometric calibration.

commons_mobile_203051.use: Exposure and colour-context reference; pose not published.

commons_mobile_203729.use: Exposure and colour-context reference; pose not published.

news1_night_wide.use: Temporary local visual comparison only; no source pixels are stored in this repository.

news1_day_site.use: Temporary local check of early-October turf, foliage, shoreline, rail and pavement appearance.

newsis_night_river.use: Temporary local check of the darkest sky and water-reflection footprint.

dark_clear_sky_median_srgb_8bit_envelope.note: Crops avoid bursts but retain unknown camera exposure, JPEG tone curves and news processing; this is a plausibility envelope, not radiance.

water.shape: Bright bridge, skyline and burst reflections are vertically elongated, horizontally broken by short waves, and spatially smooth rather than point-like sparkle.
water.confidence_grade: B for repeated morphology; D for shader widths

building_lights.shape: Window intensity and colour are irregular, with multi-floor dark groups; distant buildings do not form a uniformly white grid.
building_lights.confidence_grade: B for repeated morphology; D for occupancy parameters

vegetation.shape: Daytime site imagery shows subdued maintained turf and a green canopy with localized yellow-olive early-autumn foliage.
vegetation.confidence_grade: C for event-day colour context; mapped placement remains tied to historical OSM

limitations: None of the held photographs publishes a camera position and orientation precise enough for pixel registration.
The press photographs do not publish raw linear data, lens profiles or complete exposure metadata.
Bridge luminaire spacing, window occupancy, vegetation reflectance and water blur widths are appearance calibrations, not surveyed measurements.
Bridge fascia, piers, rooftop equipment, kerb profiles, lane paint and inferred street furniture are deterministic grade-D derived detail, not surveyed placement.
Photo-scanned asphalt, paver, grass and concrete PBR maps are generic CC0 material references, not samples collected at Yeouido.

Named 63 City, IFC, Parc.1, FKI and National Assembly geometry uses public architectural evidence, but exact facade logos, connection plates, panel textures, road damage, bridge member inventories and botanical species are not yet reconstructed.
No copyrighted photograph is distributed with the project.
